description: Growing up in the suburbs of Oregon. #confidence #selflove #beavertonoregon
transcript: My family was one of the first black families to live in Beaverton, Oregon, and like the late 90s, early 2000s. So when I say that it is in me, it is in me, it is not on me. The way that I speak, the way that I carry myself, imagine being the only person that looks like you. Freckles were not a thing on black people. Imagine being the only you in the world and how to function that way. So yeah, when I say that it is in me, it is not on me. I learned confidence from a very, very, very young age. If I didn't go get it, no one was going to hand it to me.
